verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own docs describe a built-in Files panel where you can explore the app's files and edit its code. They also describe reviewing code diffs, collaboratively modifying the generated code, and switching between code and canvas. The community extractor thread concerns getting code out of .make files via the API, not in-builder editing, so it does not contradict this. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the code editor's capabilities (e.g. which file types are editable, how editor features behave), and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-builder code editing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open and edit the generated source code directly inside the builder
